sources.snippet: Phonon is the speech recognition engine from Fermion Research. It runs the Phonon models on Apple silicon through MLX, on CPUs under Linux (x86-64 and Arm), Windows and macOS (Apple silicon and Intel Macs), and on NVIDIA GPUs through the CUDA image. It transcribes files from the command line, transcribes the microphone live, and serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Phonon-2, a 164 MB download ...

sources.title: Phonon: Tiny Open Voices for On-Device Apps - Laurence Moroney - The AI ...
sources.snippet: I have always loved the moment an app first speaks to you. Voice makes software feel present, and it opens doors for accessibility, games and hands-free tools. Gradium has open-sourced Phonon, a family of very small text-to-speech models designed to run entirely on your own device, and it arrives at a nice moment for anyone building AI at the edge.
